title: Figure 3: The EDTEK Scanning Reactor Configuration schematic
description: Cross-section schematic stamped "Proprietary" titled "The EDTEK Scanning Reactor Configuration," showing a reactor pressure vessel (Carpenter 680 alloy) with a containment chamber, high-temp super insulation, 40 watt start-up heater, palladium test sample in a hot zone, temperature probe assembly, thermocouple leads, pressurized D2 gas inlet, vacuum ports and a "Cross" fitting. Notes give max D2 gas pressure at 1000°C of about 4000 atmospheres and state all cross-sections are cylindrical. The caption reads "Figure 3. This design configuration has been built and is now in place at the EDTEK Corporation," with the controlling individual's name redacted under 1843(a)(2).
